caseNameFull: Hunt, Governor of North Carolina v. Cromartie

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. N. C. Probable jurisdiction noted. Brief of appellants is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 8 p.m., Tuesday, November 10, 1998. Brief of appellees is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 8, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 29, 1998. This Court’s Pule 29.2 does not apply.
